Specification of Execution Management
AUTOSAR AP R23-11
if previous transition ended with error. This is allowed because a failed state transition
is considered as invalid
Function Group State
.
Since
Execution Management
allows a new
ara::exec::StateClient::Set-
State
call to interrupt an ongoing transition and thus change the destination
Func-
tion Group State
of the transition, it may happen (especially in misconfigured sys-
tem, or during the development phase) that some of
ara::exec::StateClient::
SetState
requests will be issued by mistake. It is in the best interest of
Execution
Management
to inform requester (instance of
ara::exec::StateClient
) of the
ongoing transition, that it had been canceled by a newer request as soon as possible.
